## Evaluation
Verdict: Changes Requested

- [stage: plan] Plan did not split the auth module from the session module as the issue called for
- [stage: plan] Plan's task list omitted the migration step the issue body required
- [stage: plan-eval] Plan-eval flagged the missing rollback path; never addressed
- [stage: pr-eval] Unhandled error path in session.refresh()
- [stage: pr-eval] Race condition between session.commit() and store.persist()
